stepHints.CATALOG: Find the partner's offer in the catalogue of its connector (DSP).
stepHints.NEGOTIATION: Negotiate a usage contract for the offer; policies are evaluated.
stepHints.TRANSFER: Start the transfer process for the exchange.
stepHints.EDR: Obtain a short-lived access token (EDR) for the partner's data plane.
stepHints.DELIVERY: Send the message to the partner's system via its data plane.
stepHints.RECEIPT: Message received via the own data plane and stored unchanged.
stepHints.KEY_FETCH: Partner's public signing key fetched via Catena-X.

tab.intro: Every message travels exclusively through the Catena-X connectors of both partners: find the offer in the catalogue, negotiate a contract, obtain an access token and deliver. Each step is traceable here.
tab.emptyDescription: As soon as a message for this case is sent or received, it appears here with all steps.
tab.emptyManual: This case was captured manually. The customer is not connected to Catena-X, so no messages are exchanged.
tab.emptyLegacy: Legacy case from a previous system – without data exchange via Catena-X.
tab.loadError: Could not load the data exchange.

EDC.text: Eclipse Dataspace Connector – each participant's connector. Data only flows through it, never directly between systems.

DSP.text: Dataspace Protocol – the standard connectors use to query catalogues and negotiate usage contracts.

EDR.text: Endpoint Data Reference – short-lived access token for the partner's data plane, issued after a successful negotiation.

submitted.description: The revision is stored immutably and is being transmitted to the customer via Catena-X.
submitted.descriptionManual: The revision is stored immutably. The customer is not connected to Catena-X – transmit the package through the agreed channel.
